sources.title: NASA Solar Flares FAQs
sources.supports: Radiative flares and plasma/magnetic CME are different phenomena.

displayUnits: scene units; intentionally enlarged spacing, not km or physical radius ratios
limits: Procedural shapes, colors, opacity and geometry are chosen for teaching.
The corona has no fixed outer edge represented by this mesh.
Sunspots and prominence loops are stationary teaching examples, not date-dependent activity or differential rotation.
Flare/CME progress is separate from ephemeris time.
This source registry is an editorial record, not an archived observation dataset or a copy of NASA source pages.
